newsitem.title: UK: Lloyd Thompson to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd Thompson to buy back shares.

text.p: Insurance broker Lloyd Thompson Group Plc said on Wednesday it decided to implement a rolling share repurchase programme and received authorisation to buy back up to 7.8 million shares, or about 10 percent of its stock.
The company said the shares may be purchased at a maximum price equal to 105 percent of the average middle market quotations for the 10 business days before the shares are contracted to be bought.
It added that it did not currently intend to purchase more than four million shares in the period up to Jan 1, 1997, when it enters its next close period.
"Shares will only be acquired pursuant to the programme at prices that will result in an increase in earnings per share," the company said in a statement.
Lloyd Thompson's shares gained 4p to 172 by 0910 GMT.
NatWest Securities Ltd was named as agent for the rolling buyback programme.
